_comment: Committed researched-practice record (Model A′ input) — live-generation LG-S1 Inc2. Promotes the INC-1 in-test YAML_LOAD_PRACTICE fixture (research-to-node.test.ts) to a durable, committed AstgrepResearchedPractice. entryId is namespaced getff-researched-* (§Qd rule-id sub-namespace) so a delivered researched rule never collides with a starter getff-* id. Provenance host is PyYAML's own docs, resolving under the REAL Tier-0 key 'pyyaml' added in INC-1 (allowlist.ts). The rendered artifact is committed at firing/rules/getff-researched-no-yaml-load.yml (session-side pre-render, §Qa); regenerate via `npm --prefix packages/core run render:researched`.
_coverage_note: DELIBERATE demo limitation (not a bug). The single receiver-literal pattern 'yaml.load($$$ARGS)' fires on `import yaml; yaml.load(raw)` but NOT on two evasion forms: aliased receiver (`import yaml as y; y.load(raw)`) and bare import (`from yaml import load; load(raw)`). Both are tool-verified non-firing @ast-grep 0.44.1. Neither can be cleanly closed even with the now-available relational IR arm — the alias form needs import-binding awareness ast-grep lacks ($M.load over-fires on every .load()), and the bare form trades a false-negative for a false-positive class (any bare load()). This is a live-generation DEMO (value = the research→executable-rule+firing-test pipeline, cf. no-head-element), NOT a production security linter. Accepted per docs/meta-factory/research-patches/2026-07-22-getff-no-yaml-load-coverage-verdict.md (finding origin: rule-tests-surface S2, PR #1090).
title: Do not use yaml.load(); it can execute arbitrary Python — use yaml.safe_load()
